ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمُزَّمِّلُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaw ayyuhal muzzammil
ayahs.en: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],

ayahs.ar: قُمِ الَّيۡلَ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qumil laila illaa qaleelaa
ayahs.en: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -

ayahs.ar: نِّصۡفَهٗ٘ اَوِ انۡقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيۡلًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Nisfahooo awinqus minhu qaleelaa
ayahs.en: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ تَرۡتِيۡلًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Aw zid 'alaihi wa rattilil Qur'aana tarteela
ayahs.en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا سَنُلۡقِيۡ عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلًا ثَقِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Innaa sanulqee 'alika qawalan saqeelaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ الَّيۡلِ هِيَ اَشَدُّ وَطۡاً وَّاَقۡوَمُ قِيۡلًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Inn naashi'atal laili hiya ashadddu wat anw wa aqwamu qeelaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبۡحًا طَوِيۡلًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna laka fin nahaari sabhan taweelaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرِ اسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ اِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيۡلًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wazkuris ma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabteelaa
ayahs.en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.

ayahs.ar: رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقِ وَالۡمَغۡرِبِ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Rabbul mashriqi wal maghriibi laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fattakhizhu wakeelaa
ayahs.en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

ayahs.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَاهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرًا جَمِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wasbir 'alaa maa yaqoo loona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa
ayahs.en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

ayahs.ar: وَذَرۡنِيۡ وَالۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ اُولِي النَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa zarnee walmukaz zibeena ulin na'mati wa mahhilhum qaleelaa
ayahs.en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ لَدَيۡنَا٘ اَنۡكَالًا وَّجَحِيۡمًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna ladainaaa ankaalanw wa jaheemaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

ayahs.ar: وَّطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَّعَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًاࣞ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ta'aaman zaa ghussa tinw wa'azaaban aleemaa
ayahs.en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ الۡاَرۡضُ وَالۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الۡجِبَالُ كَثِيۡبًا مَّهِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Yawma tarjuful ardu waljibaalu wa kaanatil jibaalu kaseebam maheelaa
ayahs.en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُوۡلًا ࣢ۙ شَاهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُوۡلًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa arsalnaaa ilaikum rasoolan shahidan 'alikum kamaaa arsalnaaa ilaa Fir'awna Rasoolna
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

ayahs.ar: فَعَصٰي فِرۡعَوۡنُ الرَّسُوۡلَ فَاَخَذۡنٰهُ اَخۡذًا وَّبِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Fa'asaa Fir'awnur Rasoola fa akhaznaahu akhzanw wabeelaa
ayahs.en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُوۡنَ اِنۡ كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمًا يَّجۡعَلُ الۡوِلۡدَانَ شِيۡبَاۙۖࣗ‏
ayahs.tl: Fakaifa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmany yaj'alul wildaana sheeba
ayahs.en: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?

ayahs.ar: اِۨلسَّمَآءُ مُنۡفَطِرٌۭ بِهٖؕ كَانَ وَعۡدُهٗ مَفۡعُوۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Assamaaa'u munfatirum bih; kaana wa'duhoo maf'oola
ayahs.en: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذۡكِرَةٌۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ اَنَّكَ تَقُوۡمُ اَدۡنٰي مِنۡ ثُلُثَيِ الَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهٗ وَثُلُثَهٗ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِيۡنَ مَعَكَؕ وَاللّٰهُ يُقَدِّرُ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَؕ عَلِمَ اَنۡ لَّنۡ تُحۡصُوۡهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَاقۡرَءُوۡا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الۡقُرۡاٰنِؕ عَلِمَ اَنۡ سَيَكُوۡنُ مِنۡكُمۡ مَّرۡضٰيۙ وَاٰخَرُوۡنَ يَضۡرِبُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُوۡنَ مِنۡ فَضۡلِ اللّٰهِۙ وَاٰخَرُوۡنَ يُقَاتِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِؗۖ فَاقۡرَءُوۡا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۙ وَاَقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَقۡرِضُوا اللّٰهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنًاؕ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوۡا لِاَنۡفُسِكُمۡ مِّنۡ خَيۡرٍ تَجِدُوۡهُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ هُوَ خَيۡرًا وَّاَعۡظَمَ اَجۡرًاؕ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوا اللّٰهَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna Rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min sulusa yil laili wa nisfahoo wa sulusahoo wa taaa'ifatum minal lazeena ma'ak; wal laahu yuqaddirul laila wanna haar; 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaikum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal quraan; 'alima an sa yakoonu minkum mardaa wa aakharoona yadriboona fil ardi yabtaghoona min fadlil laahi wa aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelil laahi faqra'oo ma tayassara minhu wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata wa aqridul laaha qardan hasanaa; wa maa tuqadimoo li anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laahi huwa khayranw wa a'zama ajraa; wastaghfirul laahaa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem.
ayahs.en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
